objective: Improve annual account returns and drawdowns within the frozen retrospective 947-stock universe; research only
warmup: 2018-2019 trailing data permitted, no pre-2020 account positions
stability_warning: Existing development history means 2024 is not a new blind test. It must not choose or revise the winner.
universe: Exactly manifest raw/qfq pairs, expected 947; no current leader classification; retrospective eligibility is a limitation
signal_reconstruction: Run current structure.scan and independent(base mask) on all available valid trailing bars, then exclude consecutive inferred down limits and RULE special events; apply raw close<8 and close/MA20<=0.92. No mature future-return label is required.
tail_policy: Allow every 2020-2024 signal. Last-day signals are pending. Holdings/receivables at cutoff are marked and disclosed, never dropped for an unavailable mature label. Contractual future exit dates remain beyond snapshot.
search_policy: Only single-factor departures above, no combinations, no post-result expansion, no annual hindsight rule selection

selection.eligibility: Non-baseline candidate worst annual return on 2020-2023 must be >= baseline worst annual return minus 0.02, and at least 2 of 4 annual returns must exceed baseline
selection.score: arithmetic mean of four annual returns minus 0.5 times largest absolute annual max drawdown
selection.tie_break: Lower full selection-period drawdown, then lexical id
selection.fallback: Baseline remains selected unless eligible candidate score strictly exceeds baseline score
selection.robustness: Report all four leave-one-year-out rankings without choosing a different final rule

report: all candidate annual return and annual drawdown
2024 stability for fixed winner and baseline
turnover, trade counts, skips, exposure, open positions and receivables
corporate-action completeness, unresolved changes, terminal boundary events
existing retrospective pool and execution assumptions
execution: Fixed initial capital 100000, fixed slot budget capital/slots, T+1, round lots, current fees, guaranteed next-session-open entry. Daily-bar stop precedes TP if both touched. Existing daily-bar exit fill assumptions retained and disclosed.
corporate_action_gate: Successful hashed supplier responses must cover the frozen no-return QUERY_PLAN of base-signal code/years, November-December next years where inside the research boundary, and all 2020 universe codes. Actual entry and held code/year coverage is checked at runtime. Explicit empty responses are evidence; absent responses are not. Every action gets a reference-price audit; historical missing references are limitations, while actual held unresolved actions or unexplained factor changes block.
writes: Only this experiment directory; no RULE/CURRENT or input modification
execution_stages: Run every candidate only through 2023-12-31, with terminal holdings and receivables marked in NAV
Write and hash SELECTION_FROZEN.json before any 2024 account run
Run only baseline and frozen winner across 2020-2024; verify selection hash unchanged
engineering_revision: Input manifest and staging clarified before computation; candidate parameters and selection objective unchanged.
